record.question: We went to school after the rain _________.
record.explanation: Answer D: had stopped. The rain had stopped before we went to school; past perfect (D). Independent check: The rain stopping precedes the later past event of going to school; past perfect “had stopped” marks that earlier completion. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/past-perfect-simple. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
